# scripts/fetch-third-party-sources.sh downloads each file, checks the pinned SHA-256 and the release job of
# .github/workflows/build.yml attaches them (plus SOURCES-SHA256SUMS) to the GitHub release.
# Columns (tab-separated): file name in the release | URL | SHA-256 ("-" = not pinned upstream; recorded per release) | covers
